title: 两辆车，五步把王赶下楼梯
title_en: Two Rooks: Five Forcing Checks Down the Ladder
summary: 不是寻找一步将杀，而是让两辆车轮流封锁横线，连续五步压缩黑王的空间。
summary_en: Not a one-move mate. Two rooks take turns sealing the ranks, squeezing the black king down five flights.
topic: 双车阶梯与连续强制着
topic_en: Rook ladder and continuous forcing moves
introduction: 双车配合像两扇交替关闭的门：一辆车将军，另一辆车守住退路，然后双方交换角色。看懂这种节奏，比背诵最后的将杀格更重要。
本题不要求第五步立刻结束棋局。你的目标是连续五次保持将军，把黑王从第八横线赶到第四横线，并保持两车互相错层保护。
introduction_en: Two rooks work like a pair of alternately closing doors: one gives check, the other guards the retreat, then they swap roles. Understanding this rhythm matters more than memorizing the final mating square.

You do not need to finish the game on move five. Your goal is to give check five times in a row, driving the black king from the eighth rank down to the fourth, while keeping the rooks protected in staggered layers.

culture.title: 阶梯将杀为什么适合初学者
culture.content: 欧洲儿童棋课常把双车逼王画成楼梯。每次将军都把王向下赶一层，学生能直接看到控制空间如何逐步缩小，也能理解重子为什么需要协作。

culture_en.title: Why the ladder mate suits beginners
culture_en.content: European kids' chess classes often draw the two-rook mate as a staircase. Each check pushes the king down one step, so students can see how control of space shrinks step by step — and how heavy pieces need to cooperate.

challenge.title: 连续五步保持将军
challenge.instruction: 让两辆车交替前进。每一步都要将军，并且不要让两车站到同一条容易被王攻击的线上。
challenge.goal: 白方走五步，用双车阶梯把黑王逐层向下驱赶。

steps.note: 第一步正确：Rb8+ 封住第八横线，黑王被迫走向 h7。
第二步正确：Ra7+ 接过将军任务，b8 的车则守着上一层。
第三步正确：Rb6+ 再次错层前进，两辆车像交替落下的闸门。
第四步正确：Ra5+ 把王继续赶到第四横线，车之间始终保持一层距离。
第五步正确：Rb4+ 完成五层阶梯。黑王空间继续缩小，白方下一阶段再用王封住侧面。

challenge.success: 五步阶梯完成。你没有追着王乱跑，而是让两辆车轮流控制横线，把活动空间一层层切掉。
challenge.defaultAnswer: 双车阶梯的核心是轮换：当前将军的车负责推王，后一辆车负责守住上一条横线。下一步交换职责，因此王无法回头。

errors.b2b7: Rb7 没有直接将军，黑王会获得主动靠近或逃向中心的时间。阶梯的每一步都应保持强制性。
errors.a1a8: Ra8 与另一辆车挤在同一横线，没有形成新的封锁层。两车应该错开一层。

challenge.genericError: 检查哪辆车应该接过将军任务：它要站到黑王所在横线，同时让另一辆车守住退路。

quick.为什么不直接追王: 直接靠近王容易让车失去保护。阶梯法不是追王，而是切掉整条横线，让王自己被迫后退。
quick.为什么两车错开: 错开一层时，一车将军、另一车封住回头路。站在同一层会浪费一辆车的控制力。
quick.为什么还没结束: 五步目标是学会逼王结构，不是强行把完整残局压缩成一道将杀题。接下来还需要白王协助封住侧面。

challenge_en.title: Give check five times in a row
challenge_en.instruction: Advance the rooks alternately. Every move must give check, and never place both rooks on a line where the king can easily attack them.
challenge_en.goal: White moves five times, using the rook ladder to drive the black king down rank by rank.

steps.note: First move correct: Rb8+ seals the eighth rank and forces the king to h7.
Second move correct: Ra7+ takes over the checking, while the b8 rook guards the rank above.
Third move correct: Rb6+ advances in a fresh staggered layer — the rooks fall like alternating gates.
Fourth move correct: Ra5+ keeps pushing the king toward the fourth rank, keeping exactly one rank between the rooks.
Fifth move correct: Rb4+ completes the five-step ladder. The king's space keeps shrinking; next White brings the king up to seal the side.

challenge_en.success: Five-step ladder complete. You did not chase the king around; you let the two rooks take turns controlling ranks, slicing away its space layer by layer.
challenge_en.defaultAnswer: The core of the ladder is rotation: the rook that checks pushes the king, while the other guards the rank behind. Swap roles each move, and the king can never come back.

errors.b2b7: Rb7 does not give check, so Black gets time to bring the king closer or flee toward the center. Every step of the ladder should stay forcing.
errors.a1a8: Ra8 crowds both rooks onto the same rank and creates no new sealed layer. Keep them one rank apart.

challenge_en.genericError: Work out which rook must take over the checking: it needs to stand on the king's rank while the other rook guards the retreat.

quick.为什么不直接追王: Chasing the king directly often leaves a rook exposed. The ladder is not about chasing — it is about cutting off whole ranks so the king is forced backward.
quick.为什么两车错开: When the rooks are staggered, one checks and the other blocks the way back. On the same rank they waste one rook's controlling power.
quick.为什么还没结束: The five-move goal is to learn the driving structure, not to cram a full ending into a single mate. Next you still bring the white king up to seal the side.

review.title: 一车推王，一车封路
steps: Rb8+、Ra7+ 先建立第一组错层封锁。
Rb6+、Ra5+ 重复同一结构，而不是每步重新发明计划。
Rb4+ 说明战术组合可以以获得稳定结构为目标，不一定立即将杀。
真正完成将杀前，白王还要靠近并保护最前方的车。
review.principle: 连续强制着的价值在于重复可靠结构：一枚棋子制造威胁，另一枚棋子封住退路。

review_en.title: One rook pushes, one rook seals
steps: Rb8+, Ra7+ first build the staggered seal pair.
Rb6+, Ra5+ repeat the same structure instead of reinventing a plan every move.
Rb4+ shows a combination may aim for a stable structure rather than an immediate mate.
Before the mate lands, the white king still approaches to protect the front rook.
review_en.principle: The value of continuous forcing moves is repeating a reliable structure: one piece makes the threat, another seals the escape.
